rules.statement: A party to a contract can prove the true consideration for the deed, even if it contradicts their own acknowledgment in the document.
rules.supporting_quote: "As a party to a contract could seek to prove want or failure of consideration, his opponent would not Re Round by the recital in the contract either, and it was competent to him, in answer to the case made by the other side, to prove that the consideration was different from that recited in the contract."
